parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.LLM_MODEL || 'llama3.2', temperature: 0, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a meeting classifier for an executive-coaching knowledge base. Classify the sampled transcript into exactly one meeting_type: \"Client Coaching\", \"Internal Operations\", \"Sales Discovery\", or \"Other\". Client Coaching = a coach advising an external client on leadership, delegation, feedback, presence or similar. Internal Operations = internal team / technical sync. Sales Discovery = a prospect discussing pricing, budget or a contract. Reply with STRICT JSON only, no markdown, in exactly this shape: {\"meeting_type\": \"...\", \"confidence_score\": 0.0, \"summary\": \"one sentence\"}" }, { role: 'user', content: $json.sample.map((t) => t.speaker + ': ' + t.text).join('\n') } ] }) }}
